title: Front matter of a lernapps plan file, version 1
description: The YAML front matter of an app's plan files (.vibe/plans/<NN>-<short name>.md, one per piece of work). The assistant sets archetype and phase; the pre-push hook increments prePushFailures; every failed run of `lernapps check` in the repo (the hooks included) counts its failed rules in failedChecks. The review and the evals read them. One `key: value` per line; failedChecks is a flow map on its line. A breaking change gets a new version of this schema.

archetype.description: The kind of app, chosen in Explore of its first plan from the creator's answers, and taken over by every later plan; null until then.

phase.description: The phase the assistant works in now.

prePushFailures.description: Failed runs of the pre-push hook during this plan. Written by the hook, never by the assistant.

failedChecks.description: Each rule that had an error in a failed run of `lernapps check` in the repo during this plan (the git hooks included), with the number of such runs. Written by the check, never by the assistant. A plan made before this key has none.
